mentions.name: Options at the Money Premiums
mentions.description: A mobile app for options traders that displays all cash-secured put and covered call premiums on a single screen. The developer is currently building an Android version; an iOS version is already available.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on the android version of this app. It is a tiny tool for options trader to see all the premium on one screen.

mentions.name: Options: At-the-Money Premiums
mentions.description: This app is an options tracker that displays all at-the-money options premiums on a single screen, aimed at traders selling cash-secured puts and covered calls.
mentions.problem: Options premiums are hard to view together on one screen.
mentions.audience: Options traders selling cash-secured puts (CSP) and covered calls (CC)
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building an Options: At-the-Money Premiums tracker to help me view all the options premiums on one screen.
